run_symmetry_visualization: run the script to visualize 3D object models under all identified symmetry transformations and save RGB images
create_renderer: create a BOP renderer with vispy, cpp, or python backend for RGB rendering with flat shading
get_symmetry_transformations: get all symmetry transformations for a 3D object model given its metadata and max discretization step
load_model_params: load dataset model parameters including object IDs and model file path templates using dataset_params
render_object_with_pose: render a 3D object at a given rotation and translation pose and save the RGB output image
